Maria (PM): Quick intake — customer 'Greenline' asks for per-tenant quality contracts: automated acceptance checks + rollback logic. Need a short PRD skeleton: problem, goals, non-goals, success metrics, basic rollout plan. Target: sync Thurs.
Jamal (Eng): got it. clarify: they want per-tenant thresholds on generation quality (e.g., factuality and toxicity) or per-route? or both?
Olivia (SE): both are in play. customer uses multi-tenant routing: different tenants have different acceptance tolerances. They want enforcement at inference time and metric gating in deploys.
Shawn (PMM): business angle — some tenants will pay for stricter SLAs. Pricing needs linkage to enforcement level. but PRD should focus on behavior first.
Maria (PM): Problem statement draft:
"Problem: Customers need per-tenant quality contracts to ensure predictable behavior for regulated tenants. Today, we have global eval gates; we lack tenant-scoped acceptance checks and automated rollback when quality degrades. This prevents customers from trusting Redwood for regulated flows."
Eva (Design): UX note: console needs a simple per-tenant settings page + a diagnostics view showing recent evals/alerts. Keep config simple (preset tiers + advanced JSON).
Nate (QA): acceptance criteria idea:
- Config UI exists and saves per-tenant thresholds
- Runtime enforcer rejects/flags responses that violate tenant thresholds with <1% false positive
- Rollback triggers on rolling-window breach (configurable window)
- Telemetry: per-tenant drift metric emitted every 5m
Jamal (Eng): technical constraints:
- Enforcement options: 1) pre-filter prompts, 2) post-hoc eval + suppress, 3) fallback model variant
- Latency SLO: enforcement path must add <25ms p50 and <50ms p95 additional
- Storage: keep last 24h of eval traces per-tenant (default), with opt-in longer retention
Maria (PM): Goals (short):
- G1: Provide per-tenant quality policy config + console
- G2: Enforce policies at inference with graceful degradation
- G3: Emit metrics and alerts for violations and regressions
Non-goals:
- NG1: This PRD does not design billing changes (follow-up)
- NG2: On-prem air-gapped advanced analytics (out of scope)
Shawn (PMM): Success metrics (proposal):
- S1: 90% of early pilot tenants can configure policies without SE help
- S2: False positive enforcement rate <1% on pilot workloads
- S3: Rollback prevented at least 1 major customer-impacting regression during pilot
Olivia (SE): Edge cases to capture in PRD:
- Tenant requests custom evals requiring private reference data
- Model ensemble: which model to fallback to when main model fails thresholds
- Skewed prompts causing many false alarms (need ignore-lists & debouncing)
Jamal (Eng): Implementation sketch:
- Feature flag + tenant config API
- Runtime hook: after generation, run fast evalers (toxicity, simple factuality scorer)
- Policy engine: compare scores -> decide allow/flag/replace/route
- Rollout: canary on internal tenants -> pilot customers -> GA
Maria (PM): Rollout checkpoints + acceptance:
- Canary: internal + 1 pilot tenant. metrics: enforcement latency, FP rate, UX save rate
- Beta: 5 customers across tiers, no severe false positives for 2 weeks
- GA: SLA docs, basic billing plan
Eva (Design): Console mock asks:
- Per-tenant toggle, preset tiers (lenient/standard/strict), advanced JSON for power users
- Diagnostics: last 100 flagged responses + reason + quick rollback button
Nate (QA): Test plan bullets:
- Unit tests for policy engine thresholds
- Integration tests with streaming path + feature flag on/off
- Load test: verify additional evalers do not break p95 latency budget
Maria (PM): Open questions:
- Q1: Do we have ready fast evalers for factuality or do we need an eval model? (Jamal)
- Q2: How to surface overridden responses to customers (redaction vs full text)? (Eva/Shawn)
- Q3: Pilot customers — who signs up? (Olivia)
Jamal (Eng): A1: toxicity quick checks exist. factuality needs a small eval model; we can run a distilled scorer (adds ~30ms). Need cost estimate.
Eva (Design): A2: prefer redaction + reason in console + allow opt-in to view full text for audit
Olivia (SE): A3: I can onboard 2 pilots: Greenline (regulated finance) and NovaDocs (healthcare). They'll test strict + standard tiers.
Shawn (PMM): I'll draft starter pricing tiers later, will need usage delta from infra.
DeployBot: deploy:feature/tenant-quality-policy succeeded — canary flag enabled in staging
Maria (PM): Next steps: I'll assemble a 1-pager PRD with the above and tag owners. Jamal — can you add rough latency/cost numbers by Tue? Olivia — confirm pilot commitments by Wed.
Jamal (Eng): on it. ETA Tue EOD.
Olivia (SE): will confirm with pilots by Wed AM.
Maria (PM): thanks — quick sync Thurs 10am to lock acceptance criteria and ship PRD."
